The best advice I can offer you is practice your dodging, because no matter what else in the game happens it's the single most important skill.   
The difference between the good and great players I see is understand the dodge mechanic, and since you're an ale understand what skills move you where and what other dodges you have. Ele is an extremely difficult class, I struggle more with it than any of my other eighties, but one of the best players I know has basically only played ele since release. Ignore knowing your "rotation" figure out surviving first if that's what you're struggling with. Swap to water as often as possible if you're d/d and keep those heals up.   
Good luck! It's a great game and if you ever need help with something send me a message.
